summary: The full bioRxiv Table S1 yielded 16,906 paired effects for 16,909 registered genes in the wild-type fasting contrast. Both author-concordance-v2 routes passed: Pearson r = 0.99169, Spearman ρ = 0.99937, and 98.04% of signs agreed. At FDR < 0.05, 789 genes were shared between 929 author calls and 793 registered calls. The proposal and source hashes passed validation. [Author supplements](https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.1101/2024.01.29.577255v1.supplementary-material)
openIssues: Twenty Excel date labels mapped uniquely against the deposited feature list. Four ambiguous rows were left unpaired, leaving three registered genes without an author match.
The published manuscript confirms the contrast and 929 discoveries. Byte identity between the journal and preprint workbooks remains unverified.
The public records establish ten libraries per arm. Individual animal identities, pooling and the exact historical DESeq2 settings remain unresolved, limiting full reproduction.
